I have farmed in Mbeya for many years, and on this small plot I will use what I know works. I will put manure on the soil as I always do, and I will also buy a small amount of chemical fertilizer to help the maize grow strong, though I cannot afford very much. I will plant improved seed because it gives me better yields than the local seed I used to keep, and since the plot is small, my family can manage the weeding and harvesting ourselves without paying workers. We depend on the rains here, so I will not irrigate, and I do not see the need for pesticides on this intercropped field.
